t:
In this Act:

    (1) Map.—The term “Map” means the map entitled “Park Boundary-Corinth Unit”, numbered 304/80,007, and dated October 1998. 
    (2) Park.—The term “Park” means the Shiloh National Military Park. 
    (3) Secretary.—The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of the Interior. 
    (4) Unit.—The term “Unit” means the Corinth Unit of Shiloh National Military Park established under section 4.

fable.w: This section only defines terms (Map, Park, Secretary, Unit) for the Act. It establishes no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body, rulemaking, or right to sue involving any party outside the federal government. The only actor named is the Secretary of the Interior, a federal official, so there is no tempting participation reading beyond the fact that it comes from a park statute.
fable.s: (3) Secretary.—The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of the Interior.

opus.w: This section only defines terms (Map, Park, Secretary, Unit) for the Act. It sets up no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body, rulemaking authority or right to sue for anyone outside the federal government. Mentioning the Secretary and a park unit does not mean outsiders take part in any federal decision.
opus.b: 1. **Thinking:** One could be tempted to read the reference to a park "Unit" and "the Secretary" as hinting at future federal decisions. But this section only defines terms. Nobody outside the federal government is consulted, given a hearing or comment period, or given a right to sue, and no rulemaking is authorized.

qwen_chat.w: This section consists entirely of definitions for terms used within the Act. It does not establish any advisory committees, public comment periods, consultations with outside entities, or rights to sue. It merely clarifies the meaning of specific words for the purpose of interpreting the statute.
qwen_chat.s: In this Act: (1) Map.—The term “Map” means the map entitled “Park Boundary-Corinth Unit”, numbered 304/80,007, and dated October 1998. (2) Park.—The term “Park” means the Shiloh National Military Park. (3) Secretary.—The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of the Interior. (4) Unit.—The term “Unit” means the Corinth Unit of Shiloh National Military Park established under section 4.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that defining terms like "Park" or "Secretary" is part of the legislative process and thus involves participation. However, definitions are merely interpretive aids and do not create any process for outside parties to consult with or influence the federal government.
